cc:Work.dc:title: Common detected homepage accessibility barriers
cc:Work.dc:description: Automated WAVE evaluation of one million homepages selected using the Tranco ranking. Issue categories overlap and do not sum to 100%. Automated findings cover only part of accessibility; no detected error does not prove conformance.
